journey.text: One item’s journey: from “a soundbar” to a tracked product

v2changes.text:
What changed from v1

• One ShopList, sorted three ways: Buy Now, Wish List and Recurring live together, not as separate tabs to set up.
• Capture sorts itself: say it once and the agent files each item into the right list.
• Questions become taps: details are a short chat of chips, not a form.
• The agent works between visits and brings back a briefing of things that need a yes.
• Wish Jar: Cashback from everyday buys fills a wish, which links the three lists.
• Honest checkout: the agent hands off to the store through ShopBack; it never pays for you.

All prices and rates are illustrative.

v2flow.text:
First-time flow

H1 home icon or promo card → O1 Welcome (video) → O3 Three lists → O4 Your agent → 1 Seed lists → 2 Capture → T1 → T2 → T3 → 3 ShopList.

The icon button keeps its New badge until the first list is made, then shows a count of items that need a yes. The promo card can be dismissed and comes back once, after 7 days.

The tutorial video is a 45-second, 4-chapter tour. The widget plays a mock of it now; the real video is still to be made.

v2calc.text:
How the best price is worked out

For each store:
Cashback = rate × (price − voucher), up to the store’s cap. Shipping earns no Cashback.
You pay = price − voucher + shipping − Cashback.

The lowest “you pay” wins. In this sample, the cheapest sticker price loses after Cashback for 4 of 5 items.

Verdicts, in order: hit your target · 30-day low · still dropping (wait) · rising (hold off) · holding steady.

Daily compares with yesterday and charts 14 days; Weekly compares with last week and charts 30 days.

Prices, rates and caps are illustrative, seeded from the 16 Nov Good Buy briefing. Store links are searches, not product pages.
